title: NIH RePORTER Scraper – No 15k Row Cap, PubMed Join
description: Search NIH-funded research projects via the official NIH RePORTER API: keyword, fiscal year, institute, activity code, org, state, PI, award-amount and award-date filters, plus an optional PubMed join. Auto-chunks past the API's 15,000-row wall. Watch mode returns only what's new since last run.
seoTitle: NIH RePORTER Scraper — NIH Grant & Award Data
seoDescription: Export NIH-funded biomedical research projects and grants via the official NIH RePORTER API. Award amounts, PIs, institutions, study sections and linked PubMed publications.

result.eventDescription: One normalized NIH RePORTER project record returned to the dataset.
